acceptanceCriteria: witness-playwright spec and help name the receipt producer with an end-to-end example verified by a focused test or fixture run.
corvint-js-test-provider --help and help exit 0 with usage for each subcommand, covered by a focused test.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#794.

Observed: `docs corpus witness-playwright` requires a qualified receipt, but DCP-V1-049/050, the build-log entry and `corvint docs corpus --help` never name the producer. The producer appears to be `corvint-js-test-provider e2e` (stdout receipt member, `--retain` under .corvint/test-evidence). `corvint-js-test-provider --help` and `help` exit `unknown subcommand`.

Expected: the spec and help name the producer with one end-to-end example (provider e2e -> retained receipt -> discover-playwright --receipt -> witness-playwright --receipt-input), naming any conversion step; `corvint-js-test-provider --help` prints per-subcommand usage.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: DCP-V1-053 / LPCV-V0-071 provider help + producer example tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: witness-playwright receipt producer undocumented; corvint-js-test-provider has no --help (GH #794)
